note.question: How does operational flexibility shape the role?
note.overview: There is an ongoing debate on how providing a subsidy for one energy source affects the investment level of other sources. To investigate this issue, we study a capacity investment problem for a utility firm that invests in renewable and conventional energy, with a consideration of two critical factors. First, conventional sources have different levels of operational flexibility—inflexible (e.g., nuclear and coal) and flexible (e.g., natural gas).
